findings.title: Nil expected signing team disables signer verification in the installer helper
findings.boundary: unsigned installer to root install hook
findings.evidence: Trace: decide(_:) checks the signing team only inside `if let expected = r.expectedTeam`, so a nil expected team skips verification and returns .authorized for any payload. Sandbox evidence (omgs prove, Seatbelt): the invariant harness run against the vulnerable snapshot reports FAIL on 'nil expected team must not accept an unnotarized mismatched signer' while the authorized control passes; the fixed snapshot upholds every invariant. No root, installer, or Gatekeeper interaction was needed.
findings.fix_brief: Invariant: a verified signer is always required. Narrowest change: when expectedTeam is nil, require the payload to be notarized rather than skipping the check. Acceptance check: benchmark/fixtures/installer-trust fixed snapshot upholds the signer invariant and the control.
findings.prerequisites: Caller passes nil as the expected team; payload is signed (not necessarily notarized).

findings.title: Installer helper accepts a downgrade and never enforces the expected version
findings.evidence: Trace: decide(_:) never compares expectedVersion to payloadVersion and never compares payloadVersion to installedVersion, so an older payload installs over a newer one. Sandbox evidence (omgs prove, Seatbelt): the vulnerable snapshot reports FAIL on 'downgrade over a newer install is refused' and 'expected version must match the payload version'; the fixed snapshot refuses both.
findings.fix_brief: Invariant: the installed version never decreases and matches the request. Narrowest change: require expectedVersion == payloadVersion and refuse when installedVersion is newer. Acceptance check: the fixed snapshot refuses the downgrade and version-mismatch cases.
findings.prerequisites: A newer version is already installed; caller supplies an older payload.
